body.prompt: Night in a torchlit Roman command tent, over the shoulder of an angry petitioner who jabs his finger at the seated emperor; the grey-bearded emperor in a crimson cloak listens without moving.
Night in a torchlit tent, the Roman emperor sits in a wooden chair and calmly looks up at a man standing over him, scrolls on the table behind, torch flame in the background.
Night close-up in a torchlit tent of the Roman emperor's steady face, grey curly hair and beard, crimson cloak, he holds the gaze of someone off screen, torch flames blurred behind.
Night inside a dark Roman tent, a general in a red cloak turns his back and walks out through the tent flap into the blue cold night while the seated emperor watches him go.
Night in a dark tent lit by firelight, the Roman emperor sits alone in his chair beside the open tent flap, blue mist outside, he stares after someone who has left.
Night close-up profile of the Roman emperor in a dark tent, firelight on his grey beard, blue night blurred through the tent opening behind him, he looks away in silence.
In a columned Roman palace corridor in soft daylight, two courtiers in cream togas lean close together and whisper, glancing over their shoulders, braziers burning along the columns.
Soft daylight in a long columned palace corridor, the Roman emperor in a crimson cloak walks toward the camera between two blurred courtiers who turn to watch him, braziers along the marble floor.
Daylight in a palace corridor, the Roman emperor walks close past two whispering courtiers without turning his head, his face calm, brazier flames blurred behind.
Night at a lamplit Roman banquet, seen from behind the emperor's shoulder as he quietly sets down his bronze cup while blurred guests on couches laugh in the background.
Night at a lamplit Roman banquet, profile of the emperor in a crimson cloak looking away from the laughing guests blurred behind him, a bronze cup on the table, wall lamps glowing.
Night close-up profile of the Roman emperor at a lamplit banquet, grey curls and beard, calm face, guests and oil lamps a soft blur behind him.
Night in a dark quiet room lit by one candle, the Roman emperor stands alone facing the camera in a crimson cloak with a bronze brooch and slowly closes his eyes.
Night, candle glowing in a dark room, the Roman emperor with eyes closed lets out a long slow breath, faint shafts of moonlight in the haze behind him.
Night extreme close-up of the Roman emperor's face with eyes closed, a single tear on his cheek, grey beard, one candle flame blurred in the dark behind him.
Night in a stone room lit by candle lamps, an aide in a rough tunic cups his hand and whispers into the ear of the seated Roman emperor, whose face does not change.
Night in a candle-lit stone room, the Roman emperor sits facing the camera with a steady face while the aide beside him steps back and bows away into the shadows.
Night close-up of the Roman emperor looking straight into the camera, grey curly hair and beard, bronze brooch on a crimson cloak, candle lamps blurred in the blue dark behind.
In a stone palace room with daylight in the doorway, the Roman emperor stands with his hand still raised mid-sentence while three boys walk away through the door behind him.
Daylight from a doorway in a stone palace room, the Roman emperor slowly lowers his raised hand and looks after someone who has left, torches on the wall behind.
Close-up of the Roman emperor's face in a stone room, soft daylight from the empty doorway behind him, grey beard, tired eyes looking off to the side.
